name: ux-principles
description: Apply cross-product UX principles to frontend features, product copy, forms, generated artifacts, previews, errors, loading states, accessibility, and other user-facing product surfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Apply practical UX judgment to product work
interface.longDescription: Use a lightweight, humane UX lens before designing, changing, reviewing, or explaining user-facing product work. Covers user control, save flows, generated artifacts, forms, loading and error states, accessibility, and product copy.
defaultPrompt: Apply UX principles to this product change.
Review this user-facing flow for UX risks.
Improve this UI copy and interaction behavior.
